messages.subject: Problem with "extract_log_lik" in rstan 2.9.0/loo 0.1.5
parts:

> class(Duree.Incr)
[1] "stanfit"
attr(,"package")

> foo <- extract_log_lik(Duree.Incr)
Error in extract_log_lik(Duree.Incr) : Please load the 'rstan' package.

However :

So probably you do not have it as well?
